levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن كعب بن مالك

notes: The gloss «- وهو ابن ثور -» is left out; «محمد» is the second occurrence, the bare name of the shaykh's shaykh
«عن أبيه» is a bare relation: the Companion Kab b. Malik is named in the matn-line only by the text's «أبيه» reference
«ولم يذكر فيه الحقي بأهلك» is a wording remark and is left out
